links.comparator_used: General-purpose large language model, as described in the vignette, at the same AI integration level
links.outcome: Patient intention to seek care from family doctors
links.effect: Medical-specific AI framing gave higher care-seeking intention than general-purpose AI at all intensity levels; the interaction with AI intensity was not significant (p = 0.508). No effect sizes are reported in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: The medical-specific model was a label in a vignette, not a validated model. The label did not buffer the decline as AI intensity rose, since the interaction was not significant.
links.quote: Across all intensity levels, framing the system as a medical-specific AI consistently resulted in higher care-seeking intention than a general-purpose model.

design_hint: AI integration intensity and medical-specific AI labeling (disclosure framing)
